Author: BetterFingers
Name: BetterFingers
Description: Put BetterFingers dictation, commands, personas and approved workflows on your Stream Deck. The plugin is a thin adapter: it holds no workflow definitions and can only ask BetterFingers to do things BetterFingers already does.

Actions.Name: Hold to dictate
Actions.Tooltip: Hold the key to record what you say as text; let go to stop.

Actions.Name: Start or stop dictation
Actions.Tooltip: Press to start, press again to stop.

Actions.Name: Hold to give a command
Actions.Tooltip: A separate key from dictation, on purpose: a key that meant both could issue a command you were only trying to say.

Actions.Name: Cancel
Actions.Tooltip: Throw away what is being captured right now. Nothing is kept.

Actions.Name: Read the latest draft aloud
Actions.Tooltip: Hear the most recent draft without looking.

Actions.Name: Copy the latest draft
Actions.Tooltip: Put the most recent draft on the clipboard.

Actions.Name: Type the latest draft
Actions.Tooltip: Deliver the most recent draft to whatever window has focus.

Actions.Name: Switch persona
Actions.Tooltip: Switch to a persona you already made. Choose which one in the key's settings.

Actions.Name: Switch writing preset
Actions.Tooltip: Switch to a writing preset you already made.

Actions.Name: Switch application profile
Actions.Tooltip: Use a specific application profile until you switch again.

Actions.Name: Run a saved workflow
Actions.Tooltip: Run a workflow you already approved in BetterFingers. This key cannot create one.

Actions.Name: Emergency stop
Actions.Tooltip: Stop everything now: recording, speech, and typing.
